entries.desc: Codex doctor reports PASS for a healthy local adapter with .Codex/koala.json and no fake hooks/settings

evidence.note: Doctor Codex adapter scan passed 7/7 on the healthy repo, including manifest, mirror, runtime exclusions, wrapper heartbeat, global fallback heartbeat, and aux availability.

entries.desc: Codex doctor warns or fails with actionable guidance when global fallback/read-only heartbeat or aux availability is missing

evidence.note: Doctor exposes the same Codex adapter scan with actionable local-wrapper remediation, including node bin/koala-codex.js verify_codex for skipped/failing heartbeat evidence.

entries.desc: Codex doctor detects unsupported .Codex/hooks or .Codex/settings.json if they appear

evidence.note: Codex asset verification now creates negative temp projects and fails on .Codex/hooks or .Codex/settings.json, while the real repo has neither.

entries.desc: Codex wrapper command writes a structured process event with source=codex, command, storyId or active story, phase, and result

evidence.note: Entrypoint verification asserts bin/koala-codex.js writes source=codex activity and codex_cli process-events with local-wrapper entrypoint.

entries.desc: Telemetry derives session from CODEX_SESSION_ID, OPENAI_SESSION_ID, TERM_SESSION_ID, or KOALA_ACTIVITY_SESSION consistently

evidence.note: Entrypoint verification now runs CODEX_SESSION_ID, OPENAI_SESSION_ID, and TERM_SESSION_ID fallback sessions through bin/koala-codex.js and checks activity telemetry.

entries.desc: Reviewer pass/finding commands without agent attribution are rejected or hard-warned so they cannot silently become main-agent records

evidence.note: Existing reviewer/finding attribution guard remains covered; Codex telemetry changes did not relax the hard warning/enforcement path.

entries.desc: koala verify_codex passes on the repository Codex adapter and validates manifest, agents, wrapper, fallback, and exclusions

evidence.command: node bin/koala-codex.js verify_codex && node bin/koala.js verify_codex
evidence.note: Both repo-local verification entrypoints passed 7/7 and recorded codex_adapter_verification events with current HEAD/material hash snapshots.

entries.desc: koala init --verify-codex generates assets then runs the same verification logic

evidence.note: Entrypoint verification reruns init --verify-codex on a temp project; init verifies generated assets with local wrapper commands and no bare global koala init guidance.

entries.desc: verification fails if .Codex/koala.json drifts or .Codex/hooks/.Codex/settings.json are created

evidence.note: Codex asset verification now asserts manifest drift and forbidden .Codex/hooks/.Codex/settings.json fail shared checks.

entries.desc: Docs list node bin/koala-codex.js doctor and koala verify_codex/koala init --verify-codex with accurate behavior

evidence.note: README.md, AGENTS.md, .Codex/README.md, .Codex/koala.json, and init templates document node bin/koala-codex.js doctor plus node bin/koala-codex.js verify_codex / node bin/koala.js verify_codex.

entries.desc: Docs distinguish doctor diagnostics from verify_codex scriptable validation without duplicating contradictory guidance

evidence.note: Docs distinguish doctor diagnostics from scriptable verify_codex and init verification, and use npx koala-init --verify-codex for init remediation.

entries.desc: Docs do not imply prompt-only compliance or fake Codex runtime hooks/settings

evidence.note: Asset verification rejects bare `koala verify_codex` / `koala init --verify-codex` guidance and checks docs do not imply fake Codex runtime hooks/settings.

entries.desc: REVIEW or DONE preflight can read Codex verify/doctor evidence and report it as a passing gate input

evidence.note: Gate evidence tests seed fresh codex_adapter_verification events with current materialHash and assert summarizeCodexEvidence reports passing.

entries.desc: Gate output distinguishes missing Codex evidence from failing Codex evidence with actionable commands

evidence.note: Gate evidence tests distinguish missing and failing codex_adapter_verification events and remediate with node bin/koala-codex.js verify_codex.

entries.desc: DONE cannot pass on prompt-only Codex compliance when required Codex hard evidence is absent or stale

evidence.note: Gate evidence tests reject legacy pass events without materialHash and post-verification adapter edits as stale, so REVIEW/DONE cannot pass on stale evidence.
